note: Evidence record for reports/SEPOLIA-DISCLOSURE-ASSESSMENT.md §2. Produced by `node scripts/sepolia-replay.mjs --rpc https://sepolia.gateway.tenderly.co --chunk 100000 --json` on 2026-11-22. Counts only: the replay classifies each historic targetId in memory and keeps sha256 digests, so no MRN, email address or free-text identifier appears in this file.
corrections: The operator enumeration (110 events) undercounted the on-chain record by roughly 9x: there are 1008 EntryRecorded events, and the contract's own getEntryCount() returns 1008.
Zero already-hashed targets were found, consistent with the hashing fix landing in 2.6.8 after the last anchor (2026-11-14) and with production currently running BLOCKCHAIN_MODE=file.
limitations: A transaction that reverted publishes calldata but emits no event, so it is not counted by this replay.
distinctTargets.mrnOrShortId counts distinct short identifiers; not all are patient MRNs (some are user ids), so the affected-person count needs a join against the local patient store.
Only blocks up to 12187948 were scanned; no anchors exist after 12132454 as of this run.
